ordered_operations: activate transmute through the shared ActionBroker without a tutor identity in the activation arguments
create the ability object and pay mana and discard costs atomically
capture the resolution-time eligible card set with a disclosed recording test provider
force Sol Ring only after proving every offered card has mana value one
reveal and move the selected singleton to hand and shuffle the library
repeat the exact-deck activation with an explicit FAIL_TO_FIND selection
preconditions: Both scenarios are constructed with build_exact_game().
Dizzy Spell is placed in hand as test setup.
The positive scenario uses a recording provider that discloses test_override and delegates evaluator identity to the frozen production provider.
The second scenario deliberately selects FAIL_TO_FIND to prove that hidden-zone fail-to-find remains legal.
required_assertions: the broker exposes one activation with choice timing RESOLUTION
no tutor choice is recorded before resolution
every offered tutor candidate has mana value one and Twinflame is not offered
exactly one singleton Sol Ring enters hand in the positive scenario
the selected record contains the frozen evaluator ID and exact SHA-256
the disclosed override is recorded in diagnostics
FAIL_TO_FIND resolves legally without moving Sol Ring to hand

plain_english: The exact deck activates Dizzy Spell through the shared broker, with the identity choice deferred until resolution.
A disclosed recording test provider proves that only mana-value-one cards are offered, records the frozen evaluator identity, and selects the singleton Sol Ring for the positive case.
A second exact-deck execution selects FAIL_TO_FIND and proves that the hidden-zone search may legally find no card even while eligible cards exist.
title: Exact-deck transmute filters by mana value, records the evaluator, and permits fail-to-find at resolution
